findingDetails.title: Leg wiring invariants are implicit; a missing JUDGES entry crashes instead of reporting
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a module-load completeness check (every LEGS id has a JUDGES function, PROVISION_DEPENDENTS is a subset of LEGS ids) or colocate the judge with each leg entry.

findingDetails.title: Header comment calls every leg a child process; the provisioning leg resolves in-process
findingDetails.recommendation: Qualify the header sentence with the provisioning exception or move the leg note into the header.

traceabilityChecks.scope_confinement: both findings cite declared review-scope files; traceability protocols completed in iteration 3 were not re-entered

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: multi-file command surface with an executable battery and suite; standard depth applies

targetSelection.selectionReason: maintainability concentrates in the executable surface and its tests; the command doc is the router contract those files must keep true

searchLedger.hypothesis: a leg added or renamed without matching JUDGES or PROVISION_DEPENDENTS edits fails unsafely: a missing judge throws at the call site and a renamed id drops out of the skip set

searchActions.result: LEGS (8 entries) and JUDGES (8 keys) match today, but the call at 319 has no completeness check, the skip set at 61 is a bare id list, and the gate at 315 assumes provisioning is first

searchLedger.rationale: no invariant links the id-keyed tables; the failure mode contradicts the leg layer's never-a-crash normalization

searchLedger.hypothesis: the module header describes every leg as a child process while the provisioning leg resolves the shared package in-process

searchActions.result: the header at 15-16 generalizes; the leg comment at 93-94 states the exception and run() at 95-104 is a try/catch require.resolve

searchLedger.rationale: the header sentence contradicts the leg's own documented execution model

searchLedger.hypothesis: the suite re-declares the eight leg paths and they could drift from the script's

searchActions.result: the eight paths match one-to-one and stubs are written at the literal paths, so any script-side path change fails the suite

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: self-checking duplication: drift surfaces as a failing stub leg

searchLedger.hypothesis: STATUS=OK and STATUS=FAIL carry different key sets and complicate consumers

searchActions.result: OK implies skipped=0 by construction because skips require a failed provisioning leg; both shapes are pinned by suite assertions

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: asymmetry is structural, not a consumer hazard

searchLedger.hypothesis: unreferenced constants or branches remain after the command lands

searchActions.result: every constant and judge is referenced; the module is a CLI with no export surface beyond the require.main guard

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: full read finds no unused wiring

searchLedger.hypothesis: fixture helpers leak temp roots or share mutable state across cases

searchActions.result: buildRoot registers every root and afterEach removes them; helpers are small and shared

searchLedger.hypothesis: ephemeral artifact labels (spec paths, ids) embedded in code comments

searchActions.result: no spec paths, requirement ids, or packet numbers in comments

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the repository comment-hygiene rule holds across both files

searchLedger.hypothesis: the four-level root walk is duplicated between the ROOT default and GUARD_MODULE

searchActions.result: two distinct bases are intentional: ROOT honors the fixture override while GUARD_MODULE must stay with this script's repository

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: a shared helper would conflate the two bases; cosmetic only

searchActions.result: usage documents one optional flag; last-wins is the conventional single-flag contract and empty values already fail to usage

searchLedger.hypothesis: no case proves the battery writes nothing to the tree it inspects

searchActions.result: the read-only claim was verified by direct read in the security iteration and the no-write behavior is structural; a snapshot case would double-count the active coverage finding

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: claim verified by read; avoids double-count with R1-P2-004
